title: TradePlusPlus
body:
✨ **Trade Plus Plus – Simple & Safe Player Trading** ✨

Trade Plus Plus is a lightweight and convenient trading system that lets players exchange items easily — even from a distance! 🚀

---

🔥 **Features:**

💬 **Easy commands**
`/trade <player>` – send a trade request 📩
`/trade accept` – accept a request ✅
`/trade deny` – decline a request ❌

🌍 **Distance trading**
Trade with players from anywhere — no need to stand next to each other! 🧭

🔒 **Secure trade system**
Both players must confirm the trade 🤝
Once both sides accept, a **5-second countdown** begins ⏳

🚫 **No cancel after confirmation**
When the countdown starts, the trade **cannot be cancelled** ❗
Prevents scams and last-second item switching 💯

⚖️ **Safe & fair**
Trade only completes if both players fully agree ✔️

---

🎯 **Perfect for:**

* Survival servers 🌲
* Economy servers 💰
* Multiplayer communities 👥
